concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑019 (record convergence speed) is not mapped to any phase or task in the plan. The plan claims coverage of FR‑003‑FR‑019 in the summary, but the detailed phase table never lists FR‑019, leaving this requirement unaddressed.

The plan references a non‑existent requirement FR‑011 ("missing FR‑011") in the Phase 3 description. FR‑011 does not appear in the specification, so this is an over‑reach plan element without a corresponding spec item.
